summary: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp, an experimental multimodal API variant of V4-Flash with image input support, alongside a Files API for reusable image uploads.

mechanisms.reason: The model shows a large improvement in multimodal agent benchmark performance relative to the prior version, approaching a leading competitor model.
mechanisms.quote: On multimodal agent benchmarks, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp makes a major leap over V4-Flash, bringing multimodal agent performance close to Opus-4.8.

mechanisms.reason: The release explicitly frames multimodal support as enabling more agent use cases combining vision with tool use.
mechanisms.quote: Multimodality unlocks more agent use cases
